decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 3 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 49 Prebend Gardens.

Condition : 4 - Within one planting season of the date of this permission, two replacement Leyland Cypress Trees and one Holm Oak Tree shall be replanted in a site to be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The trees shall be a minimum of 1.0m tall at the time of planting. The replacement trees shall be maintained. Should the replacement trees die or become seriously damaged or moribund, then further replacement trees to the same specification shall be planted in the next planting season.
description: Erection of a detached single storey building to provide a garage and workshop to the house
